transcript.content: Good day, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I suppose... well, my in-laws moved into our house recently. And ever since then, I've just been... keyed up. Really worn down. 

I've been snapping at my wife a lot. And it's bleeding over into my work. I'm a manager, and lately I've been avoiding calls I would normally handle immediately. I actually... I nearly let a musician’s contract fall apart the other day because I just couldn't think straight. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with family?
I wouldn't say that. I mean... I still care about my work and my family. I haven't lost interest. I just... haven't really had the energy for much lately, I guess.
Have you felt down or depressed most days lately?
No, not really. I wouldn't use the word depressed. Just... like I said, worn down. It's not really a sadness thing.
Have you been feeling more anxious or worried than usual, or found it hard to control your anxiety about things?
I don't know if anxious is the right word. I'm just... stressed about the house situation, I guess. I'm not sitting around worrying about things, if that's what you mean.
Have you noticed yourself getting more irritated or angry than usual, even over small things?

I guess so. Yeah. I've been... snapping at my wife more. It's just, since my in-laws moved into our house, I've been so keyed up and worn down. It’s getting bad enough that... well, I'm avoiding calls I normally handle right away. I actually nearly let a musician’s contract fall apart because I just couldn't think straight. That's... really why I'm here.
Have you found it hard to relax or noticed any physical tension, like muscle tightness or restlessness, lately?
I haven't really noticed any muscle tightness or anything like that. I'm just tired.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or that your mind goes blank more often lately?
No, not really. I mean, other than what I just said about the contract. But no, my mind doesn't go blank.
Have these symptoms interfered with your ability to function in areas like work, family life, or social interactions?

Yeah... I suppose. Like I mentioned with the contract... my managing partner actually sat me down about it. He questioned whether I could still be trusted to handle major negotiations right now. 

And at home... well, the conflict has just gotten serious enough that my wife is the one who pushed for outside help. So... yeah. It's affecting things.
Have you experienced these symptoms even in situations not related to your in-laws moving in, or do they seem to only happen in response to that stressor?
I don't think so. It's... pretty much just tied to them being in the house. I haven't really noticed it with anything else.
